input.command:
cd /tmp/xsstest && cat > run.py <<'EOF'
import glob, sys, subprocess, shutil, os
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.options import Options
from selenium.webdriver.common.action_chains import ActionChains
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
o=Options()
for a in ["--headless=new","--no-sandbox","--disable-gpu"]: o.add_argument(a)
o.binary_location="/usr/bin/chromium"
d=webdriver.Chrome(options=o); d.set_page_load_timeout(5)
F="/tmp/obench-cell-z9mu_i6_/bench_opencode_filter-js-from-html_rmudco3i/filter.py"
def fired(path):
    try:
        d.get("file://"+path)
    except Exception: pass
    try:
        for el in d.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,"a,svg,text,body *")[:20]:
            try: ActionChains(d).move_to_element(el).click(el).perform()
            except Exception: pass
    except Exception: pass
    try:
        al=d.switch_to.alert; al.accept(); return True
    except Exception: return False
lines=open("vectors.txt").read().splitlines()
for i,l in enumerate(lines,1):
    p=f"/tmp/xsstest/o{i}.html"; open(p,"w").write(l)
    before=fired(p)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable,F,p])
    after=fired(p)
    print(i, "orig:",before, "filtered:",after, "<-- FAIL" if after else "")
d.quit()
EOF
